query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM container_registry_repository INNER JOIN container_registry_repository_manifest ON container_registry_repository.id = container_registry_repository_manifest.repository_id INNER JOIN container_registry_manifest_blob ON container_registry_repository_manifest.manifest_digest = container_registry_manifest_blob.manifest_digest WHERE container_registry_manifest_blob.blob_digest = $1 AND container_registry_repository.id = $2 AND container_registry_repository.deleted IS NULL) AS "exists!";
